summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ds-envelope summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #9a682f;outline-offset:-7px}.ds-to{font-size:12px;line-height:1.8}.ds-to Bodoni',Georgia,serif;font-size:34px;transition:transform 350ms,background 200ms}.ds-envelope summary:hover .ds-seal{background:#52644b;transform:rotate(-8deg)}.ds-action{grid-column:1/-1;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;border-top:1px solid narrative.overview: This system applies only to `/untuk-nadia-rajendra`. The portfolio, Hustler, and RSIH keep their incumbent CSS. Warm paper, forest ink, generous space, and the couple's real photograph make the page feel like a letter addressed to two people.
keyCharacteristics: Large serif names and quiet sans-serif reading text.
Square paper surfaces and a circular monogram seal.
A native envelope disclosure with restrained motion.
dos: Do preserve native disclosure semantics, visible keyboard focus, and reduced-motion support.
Do keep the local typefaces and real couple photograph with their recorded provenance.
donts: Don't apply these route-specific tokens to the portfolio, Hustler, or RSIH.
Don't add rounded paper cards or decorative imagery to this established letter treatment.
